text:
Elliot Zhang: Hey team — first day. Quick question: my Mac is company-managed, I turned on FileVault during setup. Where should I store the recovery key? Jamf shows "Device is enrolled". Also, we use Time Machine to a personal NAS — is that allowed for corp files? @DevSecOps
Samira Khan: Welcome! Short: recovery keys for company-managed devices are escrowed by IT into our KMS via Jamf. Do not keep the recovery key in plain text in iCloud or personal notes. If Jamf didn't escrow for some reason, file a ticket and IT will push the escrow. :wave:
Elliot Zhang: Got it. How can I confirm escrow status locally? Any command I can run?
IT Support: run: `fdesetup status` — should say "FileVault is On." Escrow status needs Jamf/login; check Jamf MDM profile or DM us. If you prefer GUI: System Settings > Privacy & Security shows FileVault and device enrollment. We'll verify escrow within 24h if you open ticket.
DevSecOps: Quick policy note: Never allow corp secrets to be in Time Machine or external drives unless the drive is encrypted and approved. If you must back up configs, use our internal backup endpoint or store secrets in 1Password. Treat backups as potential data exfiltration vectors.
Elliot Zhang: That raises a second point — I have a bunch of local dotfiles with API keys. Best workflow to sanitize and rotate? I can script it but want to follow standard process.
Samira Khan: Remove keys, rotate them, then add machine-specific credentials to 1Password and use env vars from the secrets manager. If you need a quick scrub: `git filter-repo --path-glob '*.env' --invert-paths` or rewrite history per the docs. Open a ticket if you want assistance.
Elliot Zhang: MFA question: is using my phone's built-in biometrics with company SSO allowed, or do we require a YubiKey for devs?
IT Support: For standard users, TOTP via Authy/1Password is fine. YubiKeys are required for privileged access (infra, production, admin consoles). If you want a YubiKey, request one via the hardware request form and we'll ship it.
People Ops Bot: Reminder: Complete Security Orientation and Phishing Simulation enrollment within 5 business days. Link: https://redwood.company/training/sec-onboard
Elliot Zhang: Thanks all. Filing a ticket for escrow check and help rotating keys.
Samira Khan: Ping me in DM if you want a quick pairing session.
IT Support: Closing loop — ticket received? Reply with ticket number and we will triage. :white_check_mark:
